data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.8m (2016: run-off deviation of GBP 1.1m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012, 2013 and 2014 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.

named_events.loss_description: high volume of North America catastrophe losses incurred during the period

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a favourable prior year reserve release of GBP 0.8 million, primarily due to positive reserve movements on Whole Account Quota Share contracts from the 2012, 2013, and 2014 years of account. This release represents a small percentage of the opening gross claims outstanding. The current year's loss ratio was impacted by a high volume of North America catastrophe losses.
